decision_table.row_match_unit: (symbol, account_mode) - a candidate is matched at most once; rows for the same symbol in different accounts are distinct candidates and never compete
decision_table.condition_evaluation: a row matches only when every entry of common_conditions AND every entry of that row's conditions holds, and no entry of common_invalidation or that row's invalidation has fired

common_conditions.source: crash_day.trigger (069500 KRX open gap) evaluated inside the 08:00-08:50 NXT window

common_invalidation: fresh resistance level used as this row's anchor changes value, moves into supports[], or disappears
the lot changes quantity or avg_buy_price (corporate action, out-of-session fill, or broker-app accumulation)
holdings row source differs from the value recorded in this row's position_source condition
either broker shows a live open order on this symbol
observed live price leaves this row's band
get_quote.price_source absent (premarket fallback to previous close) or nxt_tradable=false
any frozen policy key value or semantics changes

rungs.price_formula: fixed anchor derived in prep from the matched tier formula; price_min == price_max == anchor (zero open-session discretion)
rungs.rounding: ceil to the sell-side tick grid
rungs.submission: one single-rung proposal per rung (live/CLAUDE.md 4-0: multi_rung_requires_approval)

derivation.non_marketable: every anchor >= band max_exclusive, so the limit price is always strictly above the live price
